blocks.text: 1910 mein Thomas Hunt Morgan ne aik nar Drosophila makkhi dekhi jo aam makkhiyon se mukhtalif thi: is mutant (badli hui) nar ki aankhein aam surkh ke bajaye safaid theen. Us ne is mutant nar ko aik aam (wild-type) maada se milaya. F1 ki sab makkhiyon ki aankhein surkh theen.

blocks.caption: Morgan ka cross: walidain aur F1

blocks.text: Us ne nateeja nikala ke surkh aankh ka rang safaid par dominant hai. Phir us ne F1 ki surkh aankh wali makkhiyon ka aapas mein cross kiya. F2 ki 4252 makkhiyon mein 782 (18%) safaid aankh wali theen. Surkh aur safaid aankh ki ratio 3:1 se zyada thi, lekin ahem baat yeh thi ke F2 ki sab safaid aankh wali makkhiyan nar theen.

blocks.caption: Morgan ka cross: F1 × F1 aur F2

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab F2 mein 3473 surkh aankh wali makkhiyan chhapti hai, lekin 3473 + 782 = 4255 bante hain, 4252 nahi. Morgan ke asal F2 mein 3470 surkh aankh wali (2459 maada aur 1011 nar) aur 782 safaid aankh wale nar the, kul 4252; 782 in ka taqreeban 18% hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein; har makkhi ke saath daire mein us ka sex chromosome jora. Walidain: safaid aankh nar XrY (safaid X par recessive allele r aur kunde jaisa Y baghair allele) x surkh aankh maada XRXR (do gehre surkh X par dominant allele R). F1: surkh aankh nar XRY x surkh aankh maada XRXr. F2: safaid aankh nar XrY, surkh aankh nar XRY, surkh aankh maada XRXr aur surkh aankh maada XRXR.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.14: Drosophila mein sex-linked khasiyat (aankh ka rang) ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: X-chromosome with recessive white-eye allele (r), Y-chromosome with no allele, X-chromosomes with dominant red-eye allele (R), Parents, F1 generation, F2 generation.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Safaid danda X par r (safaid aankh), gehra surkh danda X par R (surkh aankh), aur kunde wala danda Y hai jis par yeh gene nahi. Nar ke paas sirf aik X hai, is liye us ka aik r bhi safaid aankh deta hai; maada ko safaid aankh ke liye do r chahiyen. Is liye F2 mein sirf nar (XʳY) safaid aankh wala hai.

Morgan ne socha ke shayad safaid aankh wali maada ho hi nahi sakti. Is khayal ko jaanchne ke liye us ne F1 ki surkh aankh wali maada ka safaid aankh wale nar se test-cross kiya. Use safaid aur surkh aankh wale nar aur maada 1:1:1:1 ratio mein mile. Is se sabit hua ke maada ki aankhein bhi safaid ho sakti hain. To phir pehle cross ke bachchon mein safaid aankh wali maada kyun nahi thi? Us ne safaid aankh wali maada ko surkh aankh wale nar se milaya: sab maada bachchon ki aankhein surkh aur sab nar bachchon ki safaid theen.
Morgan ne nateeja nikala ke safaid aankh ka gene X chromosome par hai, aur Y chromosome par is gene ka allele nahi. Us ne aise genes ko sex-linked genes aur khasiyaton ko sex-linked traits kaha.

blocks.prompt: Morgan ki F2 mein sab safaid aankh wali makkhiyan nar kyun theen?
blocks.explanation: F1 maada XᴿXʳ aur F1 nar XᴿY thi. Har beti ko baap ka Xᴿ milta hai, is liye sab betiyan surkh aankh wali. Aadhe beton ko maa ka Xʳ mila aur un ke paas doosra X nahi, is liye un ki aankhein safaid hueen.

blocks.title: Embryonic screening (janeen ki jaanch)
blocks.text:
Embryonic screening woh tareeqe hain jin se embryo (janeen) mein genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad check ki jati hai. Is mein ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis jaise tareeqe shamil hain.
Amniocentesis aam taur par hamal ke 15ven se 20ven hafte ke darmiyan ki jati hai. Is mein aik lambi sui amniotic sac (janeen ke gird paani wali theli) mein dali jati hai. Is dauran ultrasound probe janeen ki jagah dhoondta hai aur kisi kharabi ko dekhta hai. Sui thora sa amniotic fluid kheenchti hai jis mein janeen ke cells hote hain. In cells ko culture medium mein rakh kar chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad ke liye check kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Hamla aurat ke pait ka pehlu se kata hua hissa, neeche reerh ki haddi. Bachcha-daani mein janeen (foetus) amniotic mayi se bhari amniotic theli mein hai. Oopar jild par ultrasound probe rakha hai aur syringe ki sui pait ki deewar se amniotic theli mein jati hai. Teer janeen ke cells ke bare daire ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Amniocentesis (kitab ke Embryonic Screening box ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Ultrasound probe, Amniotic fluid, Syringe, Foetus, Foetal cells.

items: Morgan (1910): safaid aankh nar × surkh maada se sab F1 surkh aankh wale.
F2: 782 safaid aankh wale (taqreeban 18%), sab nar; safaid aankh ka gene X par, Y par is ka allele nahi.
Safaid maada × surkh nar: sab betiyan surkh, sab bete safaid.
Amniocentesis (15-20 hafte): amniotic fluid ke janeeni cells mein chromosomes ki jaanch.
